# std/null

> The null pointer: a pointer to nothing, compatible with every pointer type.

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/null.pkg) · translated by [bintables/null](../bintables/null.md) · translated by [ctables/null](../ctables/null.md)

```
struct Node
  value: int
  next: ptr Node
end

let n = new Node
if n.next == null
  print "last node"
end
```

Reading a field through `null` crashes the program. A variable declared
as `let p = null` has no pointee type, so give it one:
`let p: ptr Node = null`.
